units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Hello, and welcome to a walk. I'm Anna.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: And I'm Ben. Today is a long, lazy day in Amsterdam, in five stops.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Three of them are booked. A museum, a brewery and a dinner.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: And two we added, so the gaps in the afternoon aren't just waiting around.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Which sounds like me, standing around, with a beer.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Each chapter is one stop. You press pause when you arrive, stare as long as you like, and press play when you want to walk.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: We give loose directions. Please keep a map open as well.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: The canals have no railings, and the bicycles have no brakes.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: I'll make a bet. Somebody nearly gets run over by a bike before the brewery.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: And it will be a tourist, and it will be you.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Comfortable. Hours standing in front of paintings are harder than hours walking.
